notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

using Alea

# below than running them takes: they are interpreted, and Alea's own
# methods compile as usual.
Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

const EV = Ref{AnyBool}(true)
observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

function shr(x::DistUInt{W}, n::Integer) where W
    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))
end

components(x::Tuple) = reduce(vcat, map(components, x); init = Any[])
components(x) = Any[x]
width(::DistUInt{W}) where W = W

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))
    pr(a, z, y, t...; evidence = e)
    nothing
end

function d_channelL(x1_path)
    x2_channelL = flip(0.99)
    return x2_channelL
end

function d_receiver(x3_path, x4_SEN_FR, x5_REC_FR)
    x6_state = !prob_equals(x4_SEN_FR, x5_REC_FR)
    if x6_state !== false
     x7_state = (x5_REC_FR + DistUInt{5}(1))
    end
    x8_state = x6_state === true ? x7_state : x6_state === false ? x5_REC_FR : ifelse(x6_state, x7_state, x5_REC_FR)
    x9_receiver = d_channelL(x3_path)
    x10_receiver = (x9_receiver, x8_state)
    return x10_receiver
end

function d_channelK(x11_path, x12_SEN_FR, x13_REC_FR)
    x14_channelK = flip(0.98)
    if x14_channelK !== false
     x15_channelK = d_receiver(true, x12_SEN_FR, x13_REC_FR)
     x16_channelK = (true, x15_channelK)
    end
    if x14_channelK !== true
     x17_channelK = (false, (false, x13_REC_FR))
    end
    x18_channelK = x14_channelK === true ? x16_channelK : x14_channelK === false ? x17_channelK : ifelse(x14_channelK, x16_channelK, x17_channelK)
    return x18_channelK
end

function d_send_frame(x19_path, x20_SEN_FR, x21_REC_FR)
    x22_x = d_channelK(x19_path, x20_SEN_FR, x21_REC_FR)
    x23_ack_received = (x22_x[1] & x22_x[2][1])
    x24_REC_FR = x22_x[2][2]
    if x23_ack_received !== true
     x25_x = d_channelK(true, x20_SEN_FR, x24_REC_FR)
    end
    x26_x = x23_ack_received === true ? x22_x : x23_ack_received === false ? x25_x : ifelse(x23_ack_received, x22_x, x25_x)
    x27_ack_received = (x26_x[1] & x26_x[2][1])
    x28_REC_FR = x26_x[2][2]
    if x27_ack_received !== true
     x29_x = d_channelK(true, x20_SEN_FR, x28_REC_FR)
    end
    x30_x = x27_ack_received === true ? x26_x : x27_ack_received === false ? x29_x : ifelse(x27_ack_received, x26_x, x29_x)
    x31_ack_received = (x30_x[1] & x30_x[2][1])
    x32_REC_FR = x30_x[2][2]
    x33_send_frame = (x31_ack_received, x32_REC_FR)
    return x33_send_frame
end

function d_step(x34_path, x35_state)
    x36_ack_received = x35_state[1]
    x37_SEN_FR = x35_state[2][1]
    x38_REC_FR = x35_state[2][2]
    x39_step = !(x36_ack_received)
    if x39_step !== true
     x40_x = d_send_frame(true, x37_SEN_FR, x38_REC_FR)
     x41_step = (x40_x[1], ((x37_SEN_FR + DistUInt{5}(1)), x40_x[2]))
    end
    x42_step = x39_step === true ? x35_state : x39_step === false ? x41_step : ifelse(x39_step, x35_state, x41_step)
    return x42_step
end

function dice_main()
    x43_init = (true, (DistUInt{5}(1), DistUInt{5}(0)))
    x44_final = x43_init
    for _ in 1:8
     x44_final = d_step(true, x44_final)
    end
    x45_ack_received = x44_final[1]
    x46_sen_frame = x44_final[2][1]
    x47_rec_frame = x44_final[2][2]
    return x45_ack_received
end

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()
task = Task(run_program, 1 << 30)
schedule(task)
wait(task)
end

module AleaProgram

# Julia would spend more time optimizing the long straight-line functions
# below than running them takes: they are interpreted, and Alea's own
# methods compile as usual.
Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

const EV = Ref{AnyBool}(true)
observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

function shr(x::DistUInt{W}, n::Integer) where W
    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))
end

components(x::Tuple) = reduce(vcat, map(components, x); init = Any[])
components(x) = Any[x]
width(::DistUInt{W}) where W = W

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))
    pr(a, z, y, t...; evidence = e)
    nothing

    x2_channelL = flip(0.99)
    return x2_channelL
end

function d_receiver(x3_path, x4_SEN_FR, x5_REC_FR)
    x6_state = !prob_equals(x4_SEN_FR, x5_REC_FR)
    if x6_state !== false
     x7_state = (x5_REC_FR + DistUInt{9}(1))
    end
    x8_state = x6_state === true ? x7_state : x6_state === false ? x5_REC_FR : ifelse(x6_state, x7_state, x5_REC_FR)
    x9_receiver = d_channelL(x3_path)
    x10_receiver = (x9_receiver, x8_state)
    return x10_receiver
end

function d_channelK(x11_path, x12_SEN_FR, x13_REC_FR)
    x14_channelK = flip(0.98)
    if x14_channelK !== false
     x15_channelK = d_receiver(true, x12_SEN_FR, x13_REC_FR)
     x16_channelK = (true, x15_channelK)
    end
    if x14_channelK !== true
     x17_channelK = (false, (false, x13_REC_FR))
    end
    x18_channelK = x14_channelK === true ? x16_channelK : x14_channelK === false ? x17_channelK : ifelse(x14_channelK, x16_channelK, x17_channelK)
    return x18_channelK
end

function d_send_frame(x19_path, x20_SEN_FR, x21_REC_FR)
    x22_x = d_channelK(x19_path, x20_SEN_FR, x21_REC_FR)
    x23_ack_received = (x22_x[1] & x22_x[2][1])
    x24_REC_FR = x22_x[2][2]
    if x23_ack_received !== true
     x25_x = d_channelK(true, x20_SEN_FR, x24_REC_FR)
    end
    x26_x = x23_ack_received === true ? x22_x : x23_ack_received === false ? x25_x : ifelse(x23_ack_received, x22_x, x25_x)
    x27_ack_received = (x26_x[1] & x26_x[2][1])
    x28_REC_FR = x26_x[2][2]
    if x27_ack_received !== true
     x29_x = d_channelK(true, x20_SEN_FR, x28_REC_FR)
    end
    x30_x = x27_ack_received === true ? x26_x : x27_ack_received === false ? x29_x : ifelse(x27_ack_received, x26_x, x29_x)
    x31_ack_received = (x30_x[1] & x30_x[2][1])
    x32_REC_FR = x30_x[2][2]
    x33_send_frame = (x31_ack_received, x32_REC_FR)
    return x33_send_frame
end

function d_step(x34_path, x35_state)
    x36_ack_received = x35_state[1]
    x37_SEN_FR = x35_state[2][1]
    x38_REC_FR = x35_state[2][2]
    x39_step = !(x36_ack_received)
    if x39_step !== true
     x40_x = d_send_frame(true, x37_SEN_FR, x38_REC_FR)
     x41_step = (x40_x[1], ((x37_SEN_FR + DistUInt{9}(1)), x40_x[2]))
    end
    x42_step = x39_step === true ? x35_state : x39_step === false ? x41_step : ifelse(x39_step, x35_state, x41_step)
    return x42_step
end

function dice_main()
    x43_init = (true, (DistUInt{9}(1), DistUInt{9}(0)))
    x44_final = x43_init
    for _ in 1:256
     x44_final = d_step(true, x44_final)
    end
    x45_ack_received = x44_final[1]
    x46_sen_frame = x44_final[2][1]
    x47_rec_frame = x44_final[2][2]
    return x45_ack_received
end

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

function run_program()
    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()
task = Task(run_program, 1 << 30)
schedule(task)
wait(task)
end

(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))

  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))

(define (bv-shr xs k)

  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)

    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])

    (cond

       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))

;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))

          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))
